items.note: Eight-row schedule, net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three-stage (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) all match 741-765. The sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 and the neighbour rules are not stated, and the wire counts are only said to be fixed.
Logical interpretation g=D_in^{-1}f, the invariant across edges and gates, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route formula eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1} all follow 804-825.

Terminal sums, stage transitions, side-wire nesting, the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h), telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, orthonormal residual bases and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are all present. Missing: the bilinear forms (I-J/9 over Q, the dot product over F_2) that make neighbouring triple lines orthogonal, the ambient F^{⊗3}, and the per-time gate label table eq:motif-labels and residual table that carry the derivation.

Projections at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources, the shear frames Phi_M, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim change, the N rank-one source edges 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b and the endpoint identity I_m all match 1115-1171.

Phase frames, weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving ±1, one kernel aI+bX_v per residual basis vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and the telescoping to C^{⊗m}, including the 27-coordinate Z correction, follow 1231-1314.

L<N/2 is derived from the exact ratios, deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c are given, and S1.3.6 states that both relative deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. The explicit eta values and the step log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}) (1331-1338) that turns the deficit into the exponent are not given.

Split-into-aligned-streams proofs, the cyclic row split r=Wg+w, counter accounting, the cut-and-swap cyclic shift, absorption of b^{O(1)} offset work by Q blocks, c increasing pieces for unit multiplication, and stack-based negation all match 513-620.

The factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row, rightmost-entry pivoting, triangular transforms in descending order, the conjugated ΠD addition and the three-step pivot with one interchange all follow 1375-1446. The choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423), which makes the rational factors specialize invertibly to Z/q^b, is omitted.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} on edges via recursive interchanges, the endpoint contract giving Φ_{I_m}, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^tau), the fixed-tape parking schedule and descriptor accounting all match 1491-1615.

Top rho=O(log e) digits as a row field R=q^{2rho}≥W^k, zero-row padding, the base-m split into power-width pieces with sum O(Ve^tau), binary padding to [q^e], and the one-bit width difference follow 1649-1761.

Basic identities for C, the edge frame change as a product of directional kernels, conjugation by P_M, slots of f chunks giving one child (C^{eps})^{⊗f} per kernel, the inverse-child identity, row additions for P_M, exactly s_c children and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D all match.

The eight conditional ±1 updates with their cycles, the net parity flip with w restored, the guard intervals and bad fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, chunk swaps plus controlled shifts for each rotation, sort-based repair, the full cost and the O(V((eK)^tau+1)) basis change all follow 2013-2231. That S_0 preserves the bad set is left implicit.

Individual kernels at O(V) each, node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)) with s calls, the q_0 row chunks padded to multiples of W^{k_0}, the row split giving V/W children, LIFO parking, the recurrence with leaves for e<d^beta, the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) all match 2253-2447.

The depth recurrence A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3, the bound C_0 d^{C_1} with C_1=20, exact representation with p+Δ fractional bits, Δ=o(p), uniform packed-call overheads, conversion to H, and a single truncation with error <√2·2^{-p} follow 2457-2757.

Contraction, character cancellation without division, the DIF recursion leaving bit-reversed order B_t, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, grouped rounds H then J_E, the prefix and chunk layout L, per-round layer cost, monomial implementation, commuting truncation, error √2·ℓ·2^{-p} and the stored address L(Bj) all match.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four signed products, |h_j|≤r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred-residue extraction with carry in {0,1}, numerators ac-be and ae+bc, negacyclic reduction and the O(rp log(rp)) cost match 3233-3367.
Bilinear contraction, the procedure that keeps the LB order, the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error M(3δ+η)=√2·M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} and the O(Tp log(rp)) product cost match 3378-3494.

The maps S and T, the identity TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, the bound on N-I, Neumann inversion, A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, the normalization 2^{-2alpha^2}, the ordered numerical maps, tensoring, the linewise cost and the axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^tau)) follow 3576-3896. S4.1.1 omits the 1/alpha factor in S.
Chirp periodicity, the coefficient check against QF_t, F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ giving RF^+R=F^+, the normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for the opposite sign match 3938-3987.

Fixed exponents, b, p=6b, d, K, T and r, axis lengths, sizes, alpha and gamma, the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval count, distinct odd primes, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, and the n^{o(1)} deterministic search all match 4007-4179.

The algebra map and its isomorphism, triangular coordinates b_i, update order d..1, preservation of the padding, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the O(d^2) axis moves costing O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^tau)) follow 4204-4292.
Well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap-sign check, M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f, ιD_+g)=f*g/T, matching formats at w_c=p+2, and twist factors with error <2·2^{-p} match 4303-4401.

Chirp construction, the computed chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for F^+, digit scaling 2^{-b-2}, the six steps, and the two scalings by S undoing (u*v)/S^2 all match 4420-4541.

Bilinear error addition, phase-product error 4h_p, E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), E_w<28·2^gamma T^2 L, the final 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries follow the chain at 4560-4805.
V=Tp, the row-by-row normalized costs, margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2κ, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, absorption of log p powers and the schoolbook cutoff match 4810-4995.
No step mentions the Schönhage-Strassen conjecture, the eventual lower bound, or the liminf argument. S0 only states the time bound.

errors.says: Method: the network is arranged 'so that each of its s<Wm edge changes is a smaller interchange'.
errors.paper: s is the sum of the edge ranks, not the number of edges: an edge of rank a needs a smaller interchanges, and the total is s recursive calls (1351, 1462, 1543).

errors.says: S is defined by sums over j of e^{-π α^{-2}(j-sk/t)^2} u_j.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: stream primitives, then the rank-saving networks, then matrix shear, then the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, then simultaneous layers, then synthetic transforms and convolution, then resampling with retained permutations, then the six-step algorithm with exact recovery, then the cost table with min g_i=2κ. Two places are thinner. First, the label construction gives the budget Wm-2N+2L without the bilinear forms or the gate-label table that produce it. Second, the move from the deficits to tau=1-2^{-50} is a single inferred step without the log m<20 inequality.

steps.note: The fixed linear network on three-element subsets is reconstructed with its eight-row schedule, the exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of every scratch wire. The numeric sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, which is a real gap.
A common frame commutes with pointwise gates, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs only D_vD_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate subspace labels of an m-dimensional space, nested on every edge, with the only decreasing edges being the central 3->4 edges, each losing h. The tensor space F^{⊗3} and the bilinear forms are only implicit.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, give the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and a node makes s recursive calls in all.
Children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits >20·2^{-50} giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The log m<20 step and the explicit eta values are missing.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving in full sequence. The fixed bank-exchange network, common frames, nested labels with only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, L/N=100/539 or 101/539 below 1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, the E_1ΠE_2 shear costing rank-many interchanges, and the recurrence with ratio s/W<m^tau are all there. The weak points are omissions rather than errors: the size parameters h=100, N and m, the bilinear forms behind the labels, and the log m<20 inequality.
